# `base/display`

Presenting label/key and value facts, a collapsible region, a keyboard hint or a scrollable pane.

## Selection

- **Use when:** Presenting label/key and value facts, a collapsible region, a keyboard hint or a scrollable pane.
- **Avoid when:** The pair is an editable field, or the row carries identity and actions.
- **Consider instead:** `base/forms`, `base/item`
- **Stability:** stable.

## Import

```tsx fragment — import-only example
import { BooleanIndicator } from "themelia-ui/base/display"
import "themelia-ui/base/display.css"
```

## Composition

This family composes `base/badge`, `base/buttons`, `base/structure`, `base/tooltip`, `base/typography`.

Application policy—routing, fetching, persistence, permissions, and translation—stays
outside the package and arrives through the public props, callbacks, slots, or accessors below.

### `ContentBlock`

Kind: callable.

**Use when:** A titled section within a page or existing surface.

**Avoid when:** Needing a full card contract or a modal interaction.

**Compose:** Use title and description props; compose content within the shared section spacing.

**Capabilities:** section title description spacing; content grouping.

**Alternatives:** Card, Overlay.

```text
({ title, description, icon, titleSuffix, headerEnd, surface, flush, className, children, ...props }: ContentBlockProps) => import("react").JSX.Element
```

### `ContentBlockProps`

Kind: interface.

Extends: `Omit<ComponentProps<"div">, "title">`.

| member | required | type | description / documented default |
| --- | :-: | --- | --- |
| `title` | no | `ReactNode` |  |
| `description` | no | `ReactNode` |  |
| `icon` | no | `ReactNode` | Glyph on the title line. |
| `titleSuffix` | no | `ReactNode` | Content immediately after the title — a badge, a count. |
| `headerEnd` | no | `ReactNode` | Controls at the end of the title line. |
| `surface` | no | `ContentBlockSurface` |  |
| `flush` | no | `boolean` | Drops the surface's inset and clips to its radius, for content that runs to the edge<br>(divided cells, ruled rows); children pay their own inset. Only meaningful on a surface. |
| `children` | no | `ReactNode` |  |

### `ContentBlockSurface`

Kind: type.

`plain`: a heading and its content, no chrome. `bordered`: a ruled region the page shows
through. `muted`: a tinted region. `card`: `bordered` on the card ground.

```text
"plain" | "bordered" | "muted" | "card"
```

### `MetadataList`

Kind: callable.

**Use when:** Read-only metadata and label/value facts about one record.

**Avoid when:** Editing values or rendering a list of actionable records.

**Compose:** Pass plain labels and semantic values; MetadataList owns typography and label/value gaps.

**Capabilities:** read only facts; key value details; grid rows inline layouts.

**Alternatives:** Item, FormField.

